purpose: Frozen development observation sample; not a new independent test set or a natural-intervention result

sampling.ranking: Ascending SHA256(UTF8(salt + NUL + problem_id)), then problem_id as a tie-breaker

generation_protocol_origin.classification: FULL policy with bounded thinking plus separate forced boxed answer readout; not native_uninterrupted

local_source_references.role: Local historical runner reference: decode(8192), then Engine.answer; Gold graded afterward
Local engine reference: thinking prompt, sampling, forced boxed answer cue/cap
Local declared model/data revision and sampling reference; not a per-row execution attestation

generation_protocol_origin.source_interpretation: evaluate_online.py decodes thinking with cap 8192 and no full-policy decision hook; then calls Engine.answer. core.py adds a boxed-answer cue even after natural thinking closure, caps answer decoding at 192, and records control-prefix tokens.
generation_protocol_origin.provenance_limit: Rows retain seed/dtype/model path and answer-control metadata, but omit immutable execution code/model hashes. Current local source/config hashes are supplemental references, not proof they were the historical executed bytes. Bind archived run provenance before precise replay claims.
generation_protocol_origin.native_pilot_excluded: native_pilot_* provides a separate uninterrupted but capped protocol and is not mixed into this 100-case pool

cases.annotation_scope: Original trace only; forced answer, Gold, grade and correctness excluded from annotation view
